description: A full pie split into five device slices, separated by thin surface-colored borders.
overview: A full pie split into five slices separated by thin gaps, with a tooltip for each slice. Use it for a quick part-to-whole view of a small number of categories.
usage: Give each record a category key, a value and a `fill` that references its color, then add a label and color for every key in `chartConfig`. Point `dataKey` and `nameKey` on the `Pie` at your value and category fields.
notes: Pies work best with about five slices or fewer; group the long tail into an Other slice.
